Name: Financial Call Center
Author: Dhamos
Description:
Do you even wonder how make more money? How invest your money in a efficient way, and... You know, don't have a oiltruffle-starfruitwine farm? Well... I do!

This mod allow you to contact the Financial Call Center of ZuzuCity and buy five differents styles stocks: Governmental, Domestic, Imobiliary, Highrisk and Cripto! All ones have particupar proprieties, not just price and profit, but some 'favoreded trades', chance of no loss and probalities of scenarios!

For beging your financial-speculative life, just go to JojaMart and buy you desire stock and a Stock Call (BigCraftable), place your new telephone at a safe place and make a call with your stock, wait some days and voila! Profits!

The stocks are: 

[list]
[*] Governmental Stock (5k): A secure investment, 18% margin profit with 100% chance of no loss.
[*] Domestic Stock (15k): A basic investment, 21% margin profit with 88% chance of no loss.
[*] Imobiliary Stock (40k): A modest investment, 25% margin profit with 80% chance of no loss.
[*] Highrisk Stock (100k): A high investment, 27% margin profit with 65% chance of no loss.
[*] Cripto Stock: (175k): When you have money, but want more money. 0,5% chance of become multimillionaire!
[/list]
But... Do you already complete your Comunity Center? Don't worry! After that another shop gonna sell the stocks. Hint: It's a hot and blue! [code][spoiler]Casino, by Casino Coins, some have discounts there.[/spoiler][/code]
[url=https://imgur.com/a/Rgsaytk]Here you can find a detailed version of probables outputs. (Secure = Governmental)

[/url]After you making you business... You find someone is earning a good money with your buy&sell stocks activies...﻿ Like every good financial market.

Morris... Even after be kicked by Pierre! Well, Morris will send you letters after some investiments made, with... Well favored trades for even more profits!

First Mail:
[code][spoiler]Enrico Jewlery: Allow to use Iridium or Gold Bar to incress the quality of your low-income stocks (Governmental & Domestic), in others words: 50% or 100% more results!

Need 8 stocks calls made.[/spoiler]
[/code]
Second Mail: 
[code]﻿[spoiler]Sandra Wine: Allow use Iridium Quality Wine to have 50% cashback in Imobiliary Stocks (+20k of results).

Need 25 stocks calls made.[/spoiler]
[/code]

Third Mail:
[code]﻿﻿[spoiler]FoolsFoots Luck: Allow use Rabbit Foot to high incress the chance of good scenarios of Highrisk Stock.

New Probalities: (Worst = 1%; Bad = 4%; Normal = 25%; Good = 50%; Best = 20%).

Need 60 stocks calls made.[/spoiler]
[/code]
Forth Mail:
[code]﻿﻿﻿[spoiler]Strange Guy: Allow use Prismatic Shard to high incress the chance of good scenarios of Cripto Stock.

New Probalities: (Worst = 81%; Bad = 3%; Normal = 3%; Good = 3%; Best = 10%).

Need 200 stocks calls made.[/spoiler]
[/code]

The mails need to be seen for the favored trades to works!

Good luck and earn profits!

Future plans:

[list]
[*]Secondary Market: Allow reinvest your Results Stocks to gain even more profits! (Probalities of good and bad scenarios too)( A secondy machine?)
[*]Shiny Contracts: Add a way to make silver quality stocks (especially imobiliary, highrisk and cripto), compatible with favored trades.
[/list]- Dhamos
